_comment: Multi-step registration flows. Edited via /admin/content/flows; rendered on landing pages by the 'registration-flow' section (pick a flow in the Page Builder). Field types: text, email, phone, textarea, select, choice (button group), yesno, file. A step with showIf only appears when the named earlier field equals the given value. Submissions POST to /api/register → notification email (+ Google Sheet, + Attio when ATTIO_API_KEY is configured, labeled with attioLabel).
